hook: Akvan veers to Odisha: Telangana heavy-rain alert *withdrawn*
hook_b: Akvan veers to Odisha: Telangana heavy-rain alert *withdrawn*
tldr: IMD's Nov 18 track shows Cyclone Akvan crossing the coast between Narsapur (AP) and Puri (Odisha) by Friday noon and weakening before Telangana. The heavy to very heavy rain warning for Bhadradri Kothagudem, Khammam, Suryapet and Mahabubabad is withdrawn; only isolated thunderstorms with lightning remain.

beats.what: IMD Hyderabad withdrew Tuesday's heavy to very heavy rain forecast for four eastern districts. Wednesday's bulletin predicts only isolated thunderstorms with lightning on Thursday and Friday.
beats.why: Akvan's forecast track shifted north: it may now cross between Narsapur and Puri by noon on Nov 20 and head towards Odisha instead of Telangana.
beats.care: Trips east of Hyderabad on Nov 19-20 face thunderstorms and lightning at isolated places, not the heavy-rain warning issued on Tuesday.
